briefdescription.para: Looks up the XSdFec configuration by base address.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the configuration structure for a given base address. The table XSdFec_ConfigTable contains the configuration info for each device in the system. If BaseAddress is 0, the first entry of the table is returned.

parameterdescription.para: Base address of the device being looked up.

listitem.para: A pointer to the configuration found.
NULL if the specified base address was not found.

briefdescription.para: Initializes an XSdFec instance by base address.

detaileddescription.para: The driver looks up its own configuration structure created by the tool-chain based on a base address provided by the tool-chain.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if initialization succeeds.
XST_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND if the device is not found.
